content: Ho Towe Sor Tayikofer Wol Bisim Kristiano
Ha hammal wegdegmi ngalir rechokla re mel iremi le tayikel yar tugulul ladep, iwe ngo hatowe ma hachocho ngalir irel luluwal kala yar.
Yael semal tugulul ladep ila ye telad ngali bo yebe mongoy te tugul mele iy ye dipli, iwe ngo semal le be tayikel yal tugulul ladep ila tor semat fodog le yema mongoy.

Iwe ngo yeramtala te tugul mele yema mongoy, ila ye towe kalladiy wol semal le te ila sengal; ngo ila tor semat fodog le yema mongoy, ila ye towe sor bo ye tayikof yeramtala tema tugul mele yema mongoy, bo Deus mele yesa hafle.
Gel itey le hobela sor tayikofel lol semal boy? Masta la yal mele yebe hatugulu kofal boy we bo hare ye bung hare ye machey. Iwe ngo yebe bung bo Samol mele ye foru le yebe bung.
Yor le ye liliwaley ngo ye mel sew ral le ye palleng pelal tang ral ka tot, ngo ye sor le ye luluwaley le pangal ral ngo ye haffedegloh chog. Semal ir ngo rebe hatugulu kofal yar luluwal llufulyer.

Te tugul semal le yebe luluwaley le ye mel seral le ye palleng fal ngali, ngo iy ye foru le mil hassorol Samol; ngo semal le te tugul mele yema mongoy, ngo ye foru le mil hassorol Samol, bo mil mala iy ye kangalu Deus yal hachigchig irel mongoy we. Iwe ngo semal le yebe temechal mongoy semat mongoy, ngo ye foru bo hasarol Samol mo irel, iwe ngo iy ye kangalu Deus yal hachigchig.
Tor semal gich le ye molow le fal ngali chog llufulyal ngo tor semal gich le ye mes le fal ngali chog llufulyal.
Hare si molow, ila ngo si molow bo yagel Samol, iwe ngo hare si mes ila ngo si mes bo yagel Samol, ila te tugul hare si molow hare si mes, ngo Samol mele ye yusuwiligich.
Bo Kristus ye mes yesa molow tefael mo irel maes bo yebe mel le yar chomolow mo chomes Samol.

Ila ngo meda mele hami ikala tor semat fodog le hama mongoy hama sor tayikofer mekla wol bismi iyang? Iwe ngo hami ikala tema tugul mongoy ngo hama mongoy, meda mele hala tolpagilir mekla wol bismiy iyang? Pangachloh ngo si bela su mo imol Deus bo iy mele yebe hatugulu kofach.
Bo iwe babior we ye santus ye sor bo,

content.text: “Irel yai molow, yalol Samol yal sor,
ngo panger yarmat ngo rebe hasubugudiy mo imoy,
panger yarmat ngo re bele kaptaloh le ngang Deus!”

content: Ila pangachloh ngo sibe sor kofach ngal Deus.
Ha Towe Foru Bo Be Molfid Semal Bismi
Ila ngo siya ppoloh mo irel yach ma sor tayikofel semal mo semal gich. Habe far hatugulu le ha towe foru mekla rebe ppunglong mekla wol bismi luwul molfid iyang.
Irel yai dabey Samol Jesus mele isa gola hamayiloh le tor sew formel le ye tayikof wollifadol; iwe ngo hare semal ye chepar le sew formel ila ye tayikof, ila ngo iy mele ye tayikof molwe mo irel.

Hare yam mongoy semat mongoy mele hosa hawerisi semal bisim iyang, ila ngo tay wegdegel hachangcheng mala hosa foru. Hotowe tapeli mongoy kala ho mongoy bo yebe hatayikofa semal le Kristus yesa mes bo yagli!
Ha hafalli bo ye dela tayikof kaptael mekla hami ha yitili bo ye momay.
Bo mala Lamliyel Deus ila te kofael mongoy mo yul, bo kofael yach fel mo irel Deus, mo hopos mo rraey la Espritu Santus ye fang.
Iwe ngo semal le be yengang ngal Kristus le be iye sengal ngo yebe fel depel Deus irel ngo yarmat rebe dipli mala yesa foru.
Ila gich sibe yedamgili chog mekla yebe hasidoh hopos, iwe ngo ye tipingi semal mo semal gich bo yebe kkel yal tugul.
Ha towe hatawsi mala Deus yesa foru le fael mongoy. Pangal metmetal mongoy ngo be yoh le sibe mongoy. Iwe ngo ye tafel le sibe mongoy mongoka be hasilong semal luwul molfid.
Mala ye fel le habe foru ila ha towe mongoy fodog, ngo ha towe yul wine hare ha foru sew formel le yebe hasilong semal bismi luwul molfid.
Ha yitol chog llepdami mo Deus ikala hami ha chepar iyang. Yebe rraey lal depel semal le tor tayikof le ye wiri mo irel mala yesa foru le yesa hatuguluwey mo lal depal le ye fel!

Ngo hare yeyewal depal irel mala yesa hangi, bo wegdeg la yal ila te chapdoh mo irel yal tugulul ladep, ila ngo iy yesa tayikof mo irel Deus. Iwe ngo pangal meka te chapdoh mo irel tugulul ladep ngo molfid.
